Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.
Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?
Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .
Necessário:
Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?
Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!
O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as
Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?
Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Portuguese as a first language.

title: Product designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.
Job Purpose:
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products ( careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.
Duties and Responsibilities: User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
Data Product Development Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
Collaboration and Implementation Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.
Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products. Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications. Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience. Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
Requirements: Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows. Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products. Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, Git Hub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.
Nice-to-haves:
AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, Java Script frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
Experience in the higher education or Saa S technology sectors.
Credentials and Experience:
College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or Saa S environment.

We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
Personal laptop.
Health and wellness package.
Fully remote.

title: Blockchain developer
description:
Job Description We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (d Apps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, De Fi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity. Key Responsibilities
Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
Build d Apps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (Meta Mask, Wallet Connect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting. Requirements
3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live d Apps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, Java Script/Type Script for d Apps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: De Fi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities. What We Offer
Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.

A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office. Quem somos: Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades: Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras. Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor. Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades. Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas). Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados. Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas. O que estamos procurando:
Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações O que oferecemos:
VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!  
Junte-se a nós!

title: Fullstack developer (node.js + react + aws)
description:
About You
You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and Type Script . Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and Type Script . Experience with modern React state management patterns. Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or Graph QL APIs . Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, Dynamo DB, and S3. Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments. Strong experience with Dynamo DB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling. Experience supporting hybrid architectures , including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems. Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other Ia C tools (Cloud Formation, Terraform)
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably Git Hub Actions). Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using Cloud Watch or similar tools. Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand. Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.
You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and Type Script.
Develop and operate high-performance REST and Graph QL APIs.
Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
Model and optimize data access patterns in Dynamo DB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
Build and maintain frontend applications using React and Type Script, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.
Qualifications Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and Type Script . Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, Dynamo DB. Experience designing and operating REST APIs (Graph QL is a plus).
Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Guest services coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.
This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.
Responsibilities:
Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.
Requirements:
Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Especialista de projetos
description:
DESCRIÇÃ O DA VAGA:
Executar os projetos da área garantindo o adequado levantamento de requisitos de demandas, classificação, planejamento e controle a fim de executar a entrega das mesmas de acordo com as definições de segurança.
O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: Liderança e Execução: Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de projetos, desde a iniciação e planejamento até a execução, monitoramento, controle e encerramento. Planejamento: Elaborar cronogramas detalhados, definir escopo, identificar riscos e planejar recursos (equipe, orçamento, materiais). Comunicação: Atuar como o principal ponto de contato, garantindo a comunicação fluida entre stakeholders , equipes técnicas e áreas de negócio. Monitoramento: Realizar o acompanhamento do progresso dos projetos, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas ( turn-around ). Gestão de Mudanças: Gerenciar solicitações de mudança de escopo, avaliando seu impacto e garantindo a aprovação e documentação adequadas. Metodologia: Aplicar as melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (tradicionais, ágeis ou híbridas), mantendo a documentação e artefatos de projeto atualizados.
Melhoria Contínua: Contribuir para a evolução dos processos e ferramentas de Gestão de Projetos da empresa.
O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:
Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência sólida (mínimo de 7 anos) na gestão de projetos de TI e/ou Negócios.
Conhecimento avançado em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (ex: PMI/PMBOK, Scrum, Kanban).
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e resolução de conflitos.
Capacidade comprovada de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.
Experiência comprovada ou conhecimento no ERP TOTVS Protheus.(Técnico ou Projetos)
Certificação PMP, CSM, ou equivalente.
Experiência em projetos de implantação, migração ou otimização de sistemas ERP (especialmente Protheus).
Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex: MS Project, Jira, Trello, Asana).
INFORMAÇÕ ES ADICIONAIS
Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.
A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.
E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.
Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.
Dito isso, oferecemos:
● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;
● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;
● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

title: Senior software engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect
Role: Senior Software Engineer
Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.
About the role
Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic Dev Ops mindset.
Responsibilities
Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in Java Script where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
Contribute to Dev Ops practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.
Required
Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
Comfortable on Linux servers with a Dev Ops mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.
Nice to have
Java Script experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
Containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), Ia C (Terraform), and cloud-native operations on Amazon Web Services.
Event-driven/workflow systems (SQS/Kafka/Kinesis; Airflow/Prefect/Dagster).
Security/compliance exposure (PCI, SOC 2) and observability tooling at scale.
How to apply
Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:
Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
Linux/Dev Ops experience running production services
Any Java Script instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

title: Grc (governance, risk and compliance) systems administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension) Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: PST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Team Overview
The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.
We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.
Role Overview
As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for Audit Board and Archer Evolv (Compliance. AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.
You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Administration & Configuration
Own the daily administration of Audit Board and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.
Stakeholder Partnership
Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.
Vendor & Service Ownership
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.
Project Delivery
Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.
Documentation & Enablement
Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.
Required Qualifications
5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or Saa S platform administration
Deep hands-on experience with Audit Board or comparable GRC Saa S platforms Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance. AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise Saa S tools Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with REST API concepts and Saa S integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
Relevant certifications (e.g., Audit Board Certified Administrator or similar)
Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

description:

Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.

Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.

Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.
Diferenciais

Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.

title: Graphic designer
description:
Company Description
EMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now Saa S products.
We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.
We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.
You Are
An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.
You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and Saa S-oriented design work.
Role Description
This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.
You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing Saa S initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.
Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.
Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.
Responsibilities

Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
Support video and social content with strong visual design
Contribute to UX/UI design for Saa S and internal software products
Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without friction Qualifications

Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
Attention to detail and strong design judgment
Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Senior splunk engineer
description:
Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.
You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.
Responsibilities
1. Plan & Build
Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
Build trend and capacity analyses.
2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)
Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.
3. Configuration & Release Management
Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.
4. Security, Hardening & Compliance
System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, Su SSHi, 2 FA).
Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
Automate SOP-based operational workflows.
5. Transition
Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.
Requirements
Technical Skills
5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.
Certifications (required)
Minimum two of:
Splunk Core Certified User
Splunk Core Certified Power User
Splunk Enterprise Admin
Splunk Enterprise Architect
Optional: Splunk ES
Soft Skills
Strong communication in enterprise environments.
Clear documentation skills.
Proactive, quality-driven work style.
Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Overview
We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions. Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout Deep-dive into existing PHP/Code Igniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)

Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments Hands-on experience with Code Igniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks) Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, My SQL/Maria DB, PHP, Apache/Nginx) Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
Working knowledge of Java Script, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas

Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic Dev Ops workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments
What We Care About Most
Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early Comfort working independently without constant oversight
Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness
Experience Level
5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)
Working Environment
Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
High trust, low micromanagement
Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction
Why This Role
Real systems, real users, real problems
Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
Opportunity to be a true owner , not a ticket-taker Competitive compensation with room for growth

title: Customer success manager (brazil) — prm saas (eastern time hours)
description:
About Magentrix
Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) Saa S platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.
Role Overview
We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.
What You’ll Do
· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets
· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback
· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps
· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans
· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers
· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services
· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap
Requirements (Must-Haves)
· Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs
· 5+ years in Saa S Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results
· Solution engineering capability in a Saa S environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q& A with customers
· You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative
· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly
· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication
· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions
· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)
Preferred Qualifications
· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot)
· Exposure to global Saa S motions (serving North America/EMEA)
· Technically self-sufficient in a Saa S environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q& A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls
· Working grasp of web and Saa S fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments
· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

title: Brazil - remote: tech lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:
Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture. Frontend: Building the " Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
Dev Ops: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments. Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s " Visualizations" and that the " Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by Dev Ops.
What You’ll Do Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph . Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (Fast API), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates. The " Expert": When the Dev Ops engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.
Qualifications
Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams. Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development . Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading). Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes). Familiarity with Dev Ops/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD). Advanced English communication skills.
Good to Have: Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (Timescale DB, Influx DB). Gen AI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (Lang Graph), and Vector Databases. Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies Experience with Digital Twins , Io T, or Industrial Data. Experience with Gen AI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents). Background in Heavy Industry, O& G, or Io T data (MQTT, OPC UA).
Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
The Technology Stack
You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:
Backend: Python 3.12+ (Fast API), Kafka, Neo4j, Lang Graph. Frontend: Angular 16+, Type Script, Rx JS, Plotly.js. Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud
Desired Profile The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query. The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (Ng Rx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Revenue operations associate
description:
About Us: Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
What It’s Like to Work at Yipit Data: Yipit Data isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
Why Top Talent Chooses Yipit Data:
Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—Yipit Data might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
About Spend Hound:
is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm Yipit Data. (See this from Spend Hound’s Senior Product Manager!)
Spend Hound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
Companies use the Spend Hound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
Spend Hound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of Yipit Data market research ().
About The Role: Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?
We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, Spend Hound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.
We expect East work hours.
As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:
Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with Rev Ops and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
Target/Territory Management
Lead Generation, and
Outbound Cadence Operations.
Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows
You Are Likely To Succeed If:
Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
You have advanced Excel skills
Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you
What We Offer:
Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
Flexible work schedule
Personal laptop
Health and wellness package
Remote work
Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Engenheiro de dados especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Atividades:
Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
Requisitos:
Formação em Tecnologia.
Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
Inglês avançado;
Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.

title: Senior visual designer
description:
What is Teachable?
Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it. Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?
Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!
About your team
Our Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.
What is the role?
We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.
This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.
While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.
In this role, you will:

Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflows
What you’ll bring:

Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.) , plus motion design Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries; experience refining and scaling brand guidelines. Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.
Nice to have:
Experience working in Saa S, edtech, or within the creator economy.
Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.
While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Senior cloud engineer
description:

$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month
Fully Remote
Full-time, long-term contract

About the Company
Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.
Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.

As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .
This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.
You’ll work on:
Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and Git Ops principles Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera Cloud Checkr) Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Cloud Formation, ARM/Bicep) Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments
What You’ll Bring
5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / Dev Ops / Infrastructure Engineer Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both) Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.) Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, Git Ops, CI/CD pipelines Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment Fluent English communication skills
Who You Are
A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group
Why You’ll Love It Here
✅ Work fully remote from anywhere
✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month
✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base
✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)
✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks
✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Senior marketing designer
description:
About Shoplift
Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.
Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.
We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.
What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.
As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.
We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.
The Role
As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.
This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2 B Saa S marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.
Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2 B Saa S company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the Saa S . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.
The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2 C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of "brand recognizes brand" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.
You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.

What You'll Do
Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets
Design static ad templates for Meta, Linked In, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency
Brand & Sales Materials
Create feature landing page designs that follow "show-don't-tell" philosophy
Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale
Product Marketing Visualization
Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency
You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

You're a Great Fit If...
Must-haves:
5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2 B Saa S portfolio
Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)
Nice-to-haves:
Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
Motion design or animation skills
Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention
You'll thrive if you:
Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
Work well asynchronously across time zones
Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)
What We Offer
Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually
Benefits:
Flexible remote work
Generous time off policy
Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
Build your portfolio with high-quality B2 B Saa S work that stands out
Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency
How to Apply
Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:
When submitting you'll be asked to include:
Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2 B Saa S marketing work)
A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.
We're excited to meet you!

description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top You Tube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto. Today, with 80+ team members and over 10 M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!
Role Overview
Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.
What you’ll do Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain " Brilliance or Nothing" standards. Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and "breaking" narratives into punchy, high-CTR You Tube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible. Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team. Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of You Tube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the "click" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant. Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the " Stream Team" before go-live.
Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and "elite" visual identity across all platforms.
Your skills and experience Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and "breaking" market news into high-impact You Tube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click. Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted "fellow degen" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves. Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution. You Tube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of You Tube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels. High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis. Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity
